gloss: time deposit; fixed-term deposit; term savings

definitions.gloss: time deposit; fixed-term deposit; term savings
definitions.explanation: A type of bank deposit where money is deposited for a set period of time at a fixed interest rate. Early withdrawal typically incurs a penalty or reduced interest.

examples.japanese: {定期預金|ていきよきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{預|あず}ける→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧。
examples.english: To put money in a time deposit.

examples.japanese: {定期預金|ていきよきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
examples.english: The interest rate on time deposits is low.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧{定期預金|ていきよきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{満期|まんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: My one-year time deposit has reached maturity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{普通預金|ふつうよきん}→普通預金：23520_futsuuyokin⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{定期預金|ていきよきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利率|りりつ}→利率：21159_riritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Time deposits have a higher interest rate than regular savings accounts.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧ (fixed-term) and ⟦{預金|よきん}→預金：05420_yokin⟧ (deposit/savings). Often abbreviated as ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧ in casual speech. A basic financial product offered by all Japanese banks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定期預金|ていきよきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧: to set up a time deposit
- {定期預金|ていきよきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解約|かいやく}→解約：06129_kaiyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cancel/withdraw a time deposit early
- {定期預金|ていきよきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{満期|まんき}: maturity of a time deposit
- {定期預金|ていきよきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧: time deposit interest rate
- ⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧: one-year term deposit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{普通預金|ふつうよきん}→普通預金：23520_futsuuyokin⟧: regular savings account — money can be freely deposited and withdrawn, lower interest
- ⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧: savings — general term for saving money, can refer to postal savings specifically
- ⟦{積立|つみたて}→積立：07977_tsumitate⟧⟦{預金|よきん}→預金：05420_yokin⟧: installment savings — regular deposits over time toward a savings goal
